snapshot_qualification: Final static/shared builds and 9-case runs used the C++ files, tests, CMake declarations and six-file vendor patch set committed at this revision. Dependency lock whitespace was minimized without changing its parsed data. Subsequent records and LOC do not trigger rebuilds or P1.

upstream.source_input: authenticated archive extraction supplied through existing FetchContent source override; no upstream/cache edits

implementation: Per-owner platform DynLib, Vulkan-Hpp dispatcher, instance, device and registry; stack-only scoped TLS restoration; device publication only after complete initialization.
Physical-device selection uses original index, hardware/software eligibility and upstream capability branches. Buffer compatibility compares actual device owner, not repeated local index zero.
RAII owns each native buffer before create/allocate/map/bind can fail; optional quota charges VkDeviceMemory allocation size; weak buffer-type backreference removes self cycle.
Native buffer borrow retains external owner without double native free or quota charge; native queue callback shares upstream device-submit then queue locks.
Private adapter catches C++/Vulkan creation failures and maps Status. Vendor C++ targets use MSVC /EHsc- so C-linkage calls preserve exception unwinding; public consumer flags are unchanged.
Host terminate handler takeover is disabled by private vendor definition. Runtime imports loader PFNs instead of linking Vulkan loader. SPIRV-Headers remains a build-only dependency.
Versioned short EP_PREFIX isolates source cache identity while keeping the shader host tool below the failed nested-path shape.

build.runtime_environment: PATH unset; required HYLE DLLs beside EXE; system vulkan-1.dll
build.system_changes: none: no UAC, registry, power, firewall or driver changes

correctness_contract.region: Original upstream F32 RMSNorm -> broadcast scale -> SiLU -> residual, width 2048, rows 1/17/128, three varying inputs per shape; independent double oracle abs(error) <= 6e-6*(1+abs(expected)).
correctness_contract.native_interop: One input per shape comes from a real native VkBuffer producer using the same device/queue; borrowed wrapper retirement leaves original allocation usable.
correctness_contract.failures: Invalid loader/index, quota rejection/retirement, device first-fence failure, backend second-fence failure, buffer bind failure after real allocation; real PFN interception counts all corresponding live handles back to zero.
correctness_contract.isolation: Two real independent instances/devices, cross-thread use, nested scope restoration, own-buffer acceptance and foreign-owner rejection.
correctness_contract.validation: Khronos layer requested globally; explicit options.validation test requires/enables the installed layer and ran without skip. No VUID in final logs. Not a certificate for unexercised future regions.
correctness_contract.weights: Generated numeric fixture using local 2B width; no actual checkpoint-weight acceptance in this slice.

retained_failures: Removing Vulkan loader linkage exposed a build-only SPIR-V header dependency: explicit BUILD_INTERFACE SPIRV-Headers correction.
Patch source identity changed but host CMake cache still pointed at old source: short versioned EP_PREFIX correction.
Initial C++ integration had one weak_ptr access omission, MSVC extern-C unwinding warning and test lambda return deduction error; corrected before final runs.
Added device-owner compatibility assertion reproduced 8 pass / 1 failure on index-only matching; actual-owner comparison passed the final 9-case static and shared runs.
